meta.name: Lets Play Blind Har Chaal Ek Dhokha
meta.description: Let's Play Blind is set in the flashy and risky world of gambling. Three rich friends-Mohini, Neeta and Shanaya-play not just for money but for power and control. Things change when Mohak and Kavya join the game with a hidden plan.

videos.title: Aiyyash Queens
videos.overview: On Diwali night, Mohini, Neeta and Shanaya play a dangerous high-stakes game of power and pleasure, only to find themselves trapped in betrayal, greed and a dangerous wild card.

videos.title: Bluff Master
videos.overview: The queens get caught in deadly trap. Secrets unravel as betrayal leads to devastating consequences, leaving no one untouched.

videos.title: Dhoke Ka Daav
videos.overview: Mohak and Kavya's plan spins out of control of all the games. Murder was never on cards.

videos.title: Game On
videos.overview: The queens are forced to face a game and no one knows who's really playing whom.

videos.title: Aakhri Daav
videos.overview: Temptation runs high and loyalties blur as seduction becomes a weapon. In a world ruled by desire, someone is about to make move no one sees coming.

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: In a foreign land where games turn deadly, old players resurface and secrets are stripped bare. The final move is coming and it's not what anyone expected.
